input.prompt: An original minimalist electronic instrumental cue, 44.45 seconds, 123 BPM with occasional dotted syncopation. Clean modern tech-house / product-launch pulse, focused deep rounded synth bass, punchy restrained electronic kick, very sharp dry snare/snap and crisp open hi-hat subdivisions. A recurring tiny non-tonal digital snap integrated into percussion, sparse filtered chord stabs and a few restrained glassy keyboard notes. Start with a small tight beat, broaden bass and percussion through the middle to a confident lift, then strip back from41 seconds into a short resolved soft tail by44.4 seconds. Spacious, precise, playful and energetic, without busy lead melody. No speech, no singing, no human vocal samples, no literal notifications; newly composed harmony and motifs.
